name: Accessibility Widget by Includia
author: Includia

sections.description:
The “Accessibility Widget by Includia” plugin seamlessly integrates the powerful Includia accessibility widget into your WordPress website, enhancing its compliance with accessibility standards like WCAG and ADA. This plugin helps make your site more accessible to a wider range of users by providing a comprehensive suite of tools for customization and navigation.

With just a few clicks, you can enable a floating widget that empowers your visitors to personalize their browsing experience, addressing various accessibility needs without altering your website’s core design.

The Includia accessibility widget, loaded by this plugin, offers a robust set of features to improve user experience:

Keyboard Navigation: Enhances keyboard-only navigation for users who cannot use a mouse.

Typography Adjustments: Allows users to modify font size, line height, and letter spacing for improved readability.

Contrast Settings: Provides options to adjust color contrast for better text visibility.

Saturation Control: Enables users to change the color saturation of the website content.

Highlight Elements: Offers tools to highlight links, headings, or other interactive elements.

Image Controls: Includes features for image adjustments, such as grayscale or hiding images for users with visual impairments.

Custom Cursor: Provides options for a larger or more visible cursor.

Animation Control: Allows users to pause or stop animations on the page.

Audio Assistance: May include features for audio prompts or text-to-speech functionalities (depending on Includia widget capabilities).

CSS Overrides: Provides custom CSS adjustments for enhanced accessibility.

Reading Mask/Guide: Offers a reading mask or line guide to help users focus on content.

Tooltip Support: Enhances tooltip functionality for clearer explanations of elements.

Usage

Once activated, the Includia accessibility widget should automatically appear on your website’s front-end, typically as a floating icon. Users can click on this icon to open the accessibility panel and customize their browsing experience using the available features.

There are no specific shortcodes or block settings for this plugin, as it primarily loads an external widget script.

External services

This plugin integrates with the Includia accessibility service, which provides the core accessibility widget functionality.

  • Service Name and Purpose: The Includia accessibility widget (loaded from https://cdn.includia.ai/widget.js) enhances your website’s accessibility by providing a suite of tools for users to customize their browsing experience. This service is essential for the plugin’s primary function of making your site more accessible.
  • Data Sent and When:
    • Project ID: Your Includia Project ID, configured in the plugin settings, is sent to the Includia service when the widget script is loaded on your website’s front-end. This ID is necessary to identify your account and load the correct widget configuration.
    • No User Data Collection: The Includia widget itself (the script loaded from https://cdn.includia.ai/widget.js) does not collect any personal user data or track user interactions. It operates entirely client-side to provide accessibility features without sending user-specific information back to the Includia service.
  • Service Provider and Policies: This service is provided by Includia.
    • Privacy Policy: https://includia.ai/privacy-policy/
    • Terms of Service: https://includia.ai/terms/

Support

For support related to the Includia accessibility widget’s functionality or any issues encountered with this plugin, please refer to the official Includia documentation or contact their support team at contact@includia.com.
sections.installation:
Install the “Accessibility Widget by Includia” plugin into your WordPress site.

Sign up for an Includia account at app.includia.com.

Go to the “Installation” tab in your Includia dashboard and copy your project ID.

In your WordPress admin, go to Settings > Accessibility Widget.

Enter the copied project ID into the designated field and save your changes.

Congratulations! Your Includia accessibility widget is now configured and active on your WordPress site.
sections.faq:
Q: Is this plugin compatible with all WordPress themes?

A: While it is designed to work with most themes, some highly customized themes might require minor adjustments. If you encounter any issues, please contact Includia support.

Q: Does this plugin affect website performance?

A: The plugin loads a lightweight script for the Includia widget. Performance impact is generally minimal.

Q: How do I customize the appearance of the accessibility widget?

A: Customization options for the widget itself are managed through the Includia service. This plugin solely handles the integration with WordPress.
